title: Congressman Schiff and the deleted Roswell records

tellings.quote: you know, and he noted that all of the Roswell stuff was deleted, all the archival material,

plain: A US congressman named Schiff, looking into Roswell, the reported 1947 crash of something in the New Mexico desert, is said to have found that all the archival records about it had been deleted. The documentary filmmaker James Fox passes this on, saying Schiff "noted that all of the Roswell stuff was deleted, all the archival material," and the story is set around 1997. If true, it would mean the official paper trail for the most famous UFO case was wiped out.
